name: Ranked
description: The competitive ruleset: everything in Gecko Codes/Ranked, on by default. Add a code to that folder and it lands in this download.
_notes: Nothing is excluded, so the folder currently ships BOTH Manual Fielder Select
v4.1 and v5.0 plus the in-progress C port, and all three patch 0x80678F8C.
They build fine and their gecko names differ, so nothing here can catch it --
the fix is to drop the superseded files from the folder (or move them out of
Ranked/), not to list exceptions here.
